_comment: N4 of docs/2026-09-14_specific_force_control_design.md §11 — the ALTERNATIVE-HYPOTHESIS control for N3, plus the SAME-CODE thrust-fraction twins both N3 and N4 are read against. BASE = b1_quantile_20260907's B1_point_matched exactly (custom, N=32, simple-v3's supervision, imitation 64, velocity 0.003, point duration head at final_time_loss_weight 26, the thrust-fraction law, the raw condition set). WHY THE TWINS ARE RE-TRAINED (§11.6): the stored B1_point_matched pair was trained at c0f2b9e, 140 commits before N3's launch commit, and a 2-epoch check with the same seed and split measured the default path moving (epoch-1 val 8.381 → 7.737; deterministic: two current-code runs agree bit for bit; torch/numpy unchanged), so a stored twin would put code drift into every delta. ARMS: N4_twin / N4_twin_s2024 = B1_point_matched re-trained at this commit (the base for N3 AND N4; first, so N3 can be read as soon as they finish); N4_ratios / N4_ratios_s2024 = the base with ONE field moved, control_condition_features=ratios (the head reads mass, T_max/W and the 1-g stall speed in place of mass, T_max and S — the same information and width, so the arm starts from its twin's weights). Launch: run_ts.py frame_ablation --arms <this> --campaign 4dTrajectory/outputs/KRDU/experiments/sf_n4 (the campaign id `sf_n4` is the intents.json key) --airport KRDU --split-seed 1337 (formal: from a clean tree, the intent entry committed first). WHAT N4 MEASURES: N3 asks whether predicting the specific force removes the thrust-fraction head's class-dependent speed-rate bias; the alternative is that the δ head fails because the RAW conditioning makes T_max/W a learned ratio of two inputs. Same instrument and gates as N3 (docs/literature/control_normalization/measurements/per_class_readout.py on each arm's pred_val beside its twin's): the per-class n_x bias range (the stored twins 0.0104 / 0.0117 g, the truth's own 0.0045 g) and the heavy − B737 speed-bias gap (4.7 / 4.9 m/s). READING: if N4 closes the class bias as far as N3 does, the conditioning's presentation explains the failure and the law is not needed for it; if N4 leaves it while N3 closes it, the parameterisation is the mechanism. VETO: pooled ADE worse than its twin by more than the ~125 m seed line.
